description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development  - Rectifications of Gazette  Extra Ordinary   No. 2054/45 of 18.01.2018
categorisation: This gazette content involves the rectification of a legal/regulatory document (an Extraordinary Gazette Notification) under the authority of the Urban Development Authority Law. It deals with correcting errors in a previously published legal notice and specifies the legal effect of these corrections, making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structure.
